title: Thai Pad Crispy Exotic Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired stir fry featuring exotic mushrooms, crispy vegetables, and a hint of Thai aromatics.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the sliced exotic mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked pad thai noodles, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and Thai red curry paste. Stir-fry for about 1 minute.
Add the cooked tofu, chopped Thai basil, and dried porcini mushrooms. Stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
